tree.heading: General rule
tree.text: Except as otherwise expressly provided in this chapter, no deduction shall be allowed for personal, living, or family expenses.

tree.heading: Treatment of certain phone expenses
tree.text: For purposes of subsection (a), in the case of an individual, any charge (including taxes thereon) for basic local telephone service with respect to the 1st telephone line provided to any residence of the taxpayer shall be treated as a personal expense.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1988—Pub. L. 100–647 amended section generally. Prior to amendment, section read as follows: “Except as otherwise expressly provided in this chapter, no deduction shall be allowed for personal, living, or family expenses.”

notes.heading: Effective Date of 1988 Amendment
notes.text: Pub. L. 100–647, title V, § 5073(b), Nov. 10, 1988, 102 Stat. 3682, provided that: “The amendment made by subsection (a) [amending this section] shall apply to taxable years beginning after December 31, 1988.”
